title: Ithobalus (of the siege of Tyre)
summary: Tyrian king in whose reign Menander says Nebuchadnezzar besieged Tyre (Cory 1876). The edition's footnote distinguishes him from the earlier Ithobalus.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.note: pending CFAH reference (no CFAH anchor point or Table 1 entry found for this)

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 32; Menander of Ephesus, ap. Josephus
reign.note: In the reign of Ithobalus [or, Ethbaal]. The edition prints "beseiged". A footnote says Menander does not say the city was taken. No reign length is given for this Ithobalus.
